answer: The opal is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the dune. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, published publicly on failure, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. What survives to the karst is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
